title: Which way does the slide move now?
description: Determine the crank sense before resolving the pin velocity across the guided slot.
question: Drive A CW in the front view. Find Y (horizontal travel) at the shown instant.

answer.explanation: Drive A CW. External mesh A/B (18/30 teeth) has fixed centers. A positive, B negative. The solid key makes B and K rotate together. B negative, K negative. The top crank pin sweeps right under CW drive. The slot takes the transverse component along the horizontal slide. K negative, Y negative. The requested motion is left (in listed output order).

options.label: A
options.explanation: Y is left, while this choice gives rotates. The two frame guides constrain the yoke to translation.

options.label: B
options.explanation: Y is left, while this choice gives stationary. The pin has zero vertical speed here and nonzero horizontal speed across the slot.

options.label: C
options.explanation: This tuple matches the derived motions. The external mesh reverses K. At twelve o'clock its pin travels left across the slot.

options.label: D
options.explanation: Y is left, while this choice gives right. This would follow the input directly and miss the external mesh.
